visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white polo-style shirt with red trim and a red vest featuring the number '08', and a white pleated tennis skirt, stands in a brightly lit studio with a plain off-white background. She smiles brightly and waves her right hand toward the camera as large yellow text 'ARE YOU READY?' appears with animated stars. (2) The scene shifts to a medium full shot where she stands next to a small red prize wheel placed on a modern orange side table. An off-screen hand enters the frame to spin the wheel, which features segments labeled with 'Dancing' and 'Q&A'. (3) The camera cuts to a medium shot as she performs an energetic K-pop style dance routine, involving synchronized hand movements, waist sways, and leg kicks. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her movements and facial expressions. (4) After dancing, she appears slightly breathless, bringing her hand to her throat. An off-screen hand offers her a dark green patterned glass filled with a dark liquid. She takes the glass, takes a sip, and smiles with satisfaction, looking refreshed. (5) She returns to the prize wheel for a second spin, which lands on 'Q&A'. A digital tablet is handed to her showing images of blueberries. She appears to be thinking, touching her chin, before looking at the screen with curiosity. (6) A third spin lands on 'Dancing Again', leading to another sequence of high-energy rhythmic movements. (7) The final segment shows her receiving a purple and white pouch of 'K-FOOD' drink. She examines the packaging closely, pointing out the logo, and then receives two large boxes of the same product, holding them up with a look of extreme excitement and joy.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator; hands of a staff member appear occasionally to spin the wheel or hand over items.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with long, straight black hair and bangs. She is dressed in a sporty cheerleader-style outfit: a white polo shirt with red collar and sleeve details, a red cropped vest with '08' printed on the chest, and a short white pleated tennis skirt. She wears white sneakers and socks.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A minimalist indoor studio with smooth, light cream-colored walls and a light-colored floor. The only furniture is a stylized, hour-glass shaped orange plastic side table holding a red prize wheel and some white papers.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female voice greeting the audience with an enthusiastic 'Ready?'. A steady, low-volume synth pad plays in the background. (2) A distinctive mechanical 'click-clack' sound follows as the prize wheel is spun, accompanied by a cartoonish 'whoosh' sound effect as the camera zooms. (3) The BGM transitions into a bright, high-tempo K-pop track with a strong 4/4 electronic beat and female English vocals ('Hands up!'). The female speaker's voice is high-arousal and energetic. (4) A short 'ding' sound indicates the wheel stopping. The music lowers slightly (ducking) to allow the female speaker to explain she is thirsty. A soft 'gulp' sound is heard as she drinks. (5) A comical buzzer SFX plays when she guesses incorrectly on the Q&A, followed later by a celebratory 'chime' when the correct answer 'Wild Chokeberry' is revealed. (6) A male narrator's voice, deeper and more professional in tone, enters during the final third of the video to explain the health benefits of the Korean Ginseng and Chokeberry drink over the ongoing upbeat BGM. (7) The video concludes with several 'pop' and 'magic sparkle' SFX as multiple boxes of the product are presented, accompanied by the female speaker's high-pitched shouts of excitement and gratitude.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Game/Challenge -> Product Reveal -> Benefits -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote 'K-FOOD' Korean Ginseng and Wild Chokeberry drink by using a popular influencer, a gamified 'prize wheel' format, and energetic dancing to capture attention before pivoting to an endorsement of the product's health and beauty benefits.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features a direct product reveal, a list of health benefits, and the creator posing with large quantities of the branded product.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully merges social media trends (dance challenges) with traditional advertising techniques. The fast editing and high-energy SFX are optimized for short-form video platforms.
